## 0.1.1 (2026-10-28)

### 🚀 Features

- **devtools:** model retained planner evidence (MAE-897) ([#326](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/326))
- **devtools:** show planner evidence in request details (MAE-897) ([#327](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/327))
- **devtools:** explain setup and missing evidence (MAE-898) ([c29674e3](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/commit/c29674e3))
- **evals:** capture prompt cache usage and cost ([#335](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/335))

### 🩹 Fixes

- **deps:** patch advisories and validate SDK artifacts ([b8ac9a12](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/commit/b8ac9a12))
  SDK bundles include Zod 4.6.6. Oversized constrained collections fail before
  their entries are parsed. Upgrade the SDK to replace the embedded Zod copy.
- **planner-llm:** retain existing tiling instances by default ([#342](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/342))

### Upgrade

Upgrade all `@maelstrom-co/*` packages to `0.1.1` together. Planner integrations
also need TanStack AI 1.0 and matching provider adapters. Follow the
[TanStack AI migration guide](https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/migration/v1)
for the [included migration](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/334).
